# KI-131 — Helper HTTP core

**Lane:** helper · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-110 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/http.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/http.test.ts`

## Outcome

`packages/agent/src/local/http.ts` exports `createHelperServer`, the helper's whole HTTP layer on plain `node:http`:

- binds `127.0.0.1` only and reports the bound port and canonical origin;
- enforces the L11 guards exactly: Host allow-list (`421 misdirected`), cookie mutations need `x-khala-local: 1` and a same-origin `Origin` (`403 forbidden_origin`), bearer requests skip the cookie checks, no CORS headers ever;
- parses JSON bodies with a 64 KiB cap (`413 payload_too_large`), routes requests to `LocalRoute`s with decoded path params, builds the L8 `LocalRequest` (with an `AbortSignal` that fires when the client disconnects) and maps route results and failures to `{ "error": <code> }`;
- serves `GET /healthz`;
- serves the built web app from a directory with SPA fallback, `cache-control: no-cache`, a strict CSP on HTML, `503 web_not_built` when the build is missing, and no path traversal;
- calls `onIdle()` after `idleMs` with no request in flight (an open long-poll is a request in flight).

Operator-visible: AE11 (foreign `Host` → 421; cookie mutation without `x-khala-local` or with a foreign `Origin` → 403), the local web app loads at `http://127.0.0.1:47830/…` with no CSP violations, and the helper exits after 10 idle minutes (D2). Tests run a real server on port 0.

## Context and evidence

- **D2** (loopback only, idle exit), **D4** (the helper serves the full web app), KTD7 (plain `node:http`, zero new dependencies), KTD8 (loopback bind, Host allow-list 421, cookie mutations need `x-khala-local: 1` and same-origin `Origin` 403, no CORS, tokens never logged).
- AE5 (owner opens the open link and the full app renders), AE11 (boundaries), AE12 ("Delete … ends members' streams" — relies on the abort/close plumbing here).
- research-2 §7 (DNS-rebinding defence by Host allow-list; no CORS), research-4 / `docs/build/internal/research/web-seam.md` §6 (serving `dist-local`, SPA fallback, local CSP, secure context needs `127.0.0.1`).
- The hosted gateway already solves the same guard problems in another runtime; copy its shapes, not its code (packages cannot import `apps/control`): exact error envelope and sanitized logging (`apps/control/src/runtime/handler.ts:41-60`), body cap enforced on actual bytes (`apps/control/src/runtime/handler.ts:68-90`), mutation origin check (`apps/control/src/auth/csrf.ts:14-20`).
- **CSP verified against the web app at `5ad41c8b`:** the hosted CSP (`apps/web/src/composition/human/hosted-config.ts:55-70`) adds `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` and `worker-src blob:` only for Matrix crypto, which the local bundle excludes (L13); Google Fonts are dropped (the local build bundles `brand/fonts.css` woff2, `apps/web/src/brand/fonts.css:9`); images are bundled `'self'` or small inlined `data:` URIs (`apps/web/src/ui/khala/KhalaApp.tsx:6`, `apps/web/src/ui/khala/identity.ts:97-101`); no inline `<script>` in `apps/web/index.html:1-16`; no workers, audio, iframes or `eval` in `apps/web/src`. The brief's CSP below is therefore sufficient; `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` stays because the shared component library and React style props need it.

4. Static SPA serving.

## Contract and invariants

Contracts L8, verbatim (the parts this ticket produces or consumes):

```ts
import type { IncomingHttpHeaders } from 'node:http';
export type LocalRequest = {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE'; path: string; query: URLSearchParams; headers: IncomingHttpHeaders;
  body: unknown;                       // parsed JSON (undefined for GET/DELETE or empty body); invalid JSON is rejected by the server with 400 before routing
  auth: LocalAuth; origin: string;     // origin = "http://127.0.0.1:<port>" (the helper's canonical origin)
  signal: AbortSignal;                 // aborted when the client disconnects (long-poll)
};
export type LocalAuth =
  | { kind: 'none' }
  | { kind: 'owner'; via: 'cookie' | 'admin' }
  | { kind: 'agent'; userId: string; roomId: string };
export type LocalResponse =
  | { status: number; json?: unknown; headers?: Record<string, string> }
  | { status: 302; location: string; headers?: Record<string, string> };
export type LocalRoute = { method: LocalRequest['method']; pattern: RegExp; handle(req: LocalRequest, params: string[], ctx: HelperContext): Promise<LocalResponse> };
export type HelperContext = { store: LocalStore; origin: string; now(): number; random(bytes: number): Uint8Array; version: string;
  mintOpenToken(roomId?: string): { token: string; expiresAt: string }; consumeOpenToken(token: string): { roomId?: string } | null;   // in memory
  joins: Map<string, PendingJoin> };
```

Contracts L11, verbatim (the bullets this ticket implements):

> - Binds `127.0.0.1` only, port `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT` or `LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT` (47830). `EADDRINUSE`: if `GET /healthz` on that port answers `{ok:true}` the new process exits 0 (another helper owns it); otherwise it fails with `port_in_use` (no silent port move: links embed the port).
> - **Host guard:** every request's `Host` must be `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>`; else `421 {"error":"misdirected"}` (DNS-rebinding defence). No CORS headers are ever sent.
> - **Mutation guard:** non-GET requests authenticated by cookie must carry `x-khala-local: 1` and, when an `Origin` header is present, it must equal the helper origin; else `403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}`. Bearer-authenticated requests (agents, CLI) skip the cookie checks.
> - **Owner cookie:** `khala_local_owner=<43-char random>`; `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/`; no `Secure` (plain loopback). Session ids live in memory; a helper restart signs the browser out until `khala local open` mints a new open link. `/open/<token>` is the only way to obtain the cookie.
> - **Idle exit (D2):** the helper exits 0 after `KHALA_LOCAL_IDLE_MS` (default `LOCAL_IDLE_EXIT_MS`) with no request and no open long-poll. It is never installed as a service.
> - **Static web app:** `GET` of any non-`/api/`, non-`/open/`, non-`/healthz` path serves `apps/web/dist-local/` (env override `KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR`), with SPA fallback to `index.html`; assets get `cache-control: no-cache`. A missing build answers `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}` and the CLI tells the user to run `pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local`.

(The bind address and `idleMs`/`onIdle` are this ticket's; reading `KHALA_LOCAL_PORT`/`KHALA_LOCAL_IDLE_MS`/`KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR`, the `EADDRINUSE` probe and the exit are KI-137's.)

Contracts L5 error codes, verbatim: "Errors: `401 unauthorized` (no or bad token/cookie), `403 not_member` (removed or never a member), `404 not_found` (unknown room), `400 invalid_request`, `413 payload_too_large` (body > 64 KiB), `409 conflict` (PUT for another user)." This ticket emits `400 invalid_request` (bad JSON, bad percent-encoding), `413 payload_too_large` and `404 not_found` (no route); the others belong to routes.

Contracts L6, verbatim (lines this ticket serves directly or must route around):

```ts
// GET    /open/<43-char token>                                → 302 to /channels/<encodeURIComponent(roomId)> or /channels; sets the owner cookie; single use
// GET    /join/<token>                                        → the web app (SPA); the token is NOT consumed by a browser GET
// GET    /healthz                                             → { ok: true, version: string, pid: number }   (no auth, no data)
```

### This ticket's pinned API (KI-137 quotes it verbatim)

```ts
// packages/agent/src/local/http.ts
export const LOCAL_OWNER_COOKIE = 'khala_local_owner';
export const LOCAL_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES = 65_536;
export const LOCAL_CSP = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'";
export type HelperServerOptions = {
  port: number;                                    // 0 = ephemeral (tests); always bound on 127.0.0.1
  routes: readonly LocalRoute[];                   // tried in array order
  createContext(origin: string): HelperContext;    // called exactly once, inside listen(), after the port is known
  webDir: string;                                  // absolute directory holding index.html and assets/
  idleMs: number;
  onIdle(): void;                                  // called at most once per idle period; the server keeps running (KI-137 decides to close)
  authenticateCookie(value: string): boolean;      // value already matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/
  authenticateBearer(token: string): LocalAuth;    // { kind: 'none' } for an unknown token; never throws
  log?: (line: string) => void;                    // default: line => process.stderr.write(line + '\n'); never receives bodies, tokens, cookies, query strings or paths
};
export type HelperServer = {
  listen(): Promise<{ port: number; origin: string }>;   // origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`; rejects with the original Node error (err.code 'EADDRINUSE' etc.)
  close(): Promise<void>;                                // stops accepting, aborts every in-flight LocalRequest.signal, closes all sockets, clears the idle timer; idempotent
};
export function createHelperServer(options: HelperServerOptions): HelperServer;
```

Deviation from the planner's sketch: `ctx: HelperContext` became `createContext(origin)` because `HelperContext.origin` (L8) is only known after binding (port 0 in tests, and KI-137 builds the context's origin-dependent parts such as `confirmUrl` from it).

### Request pipeline (exact order)

1. Count the request in flight (idle timer cleared); un-count on the response's `close` event.
2. **Host guard**: `req.headers.host` lower-cased must equal `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>` → else `421 {"error":"misdirected"}`.
3. **Method**: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE` only → else `405 {"error":"method_not_allowed"}` (this includes `OPTIONS`: there is no CORS preflight answer).
4. **URL**: `new URL(req.url, origin)`; failure → `400 {"error":"invalid_request"}`. `path = url.pathname` (still percent-encoded).
5. `GET /healthz` → `200 {"ok":true,"version":ctx.version,"pid":process.pid}`. Any other method on `/healthz` → 405.
6. **Auth**: if `authorization` matches `/^Bearer ([A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,256})$/` → `auth = authenticateBearer(token)`, `bearer = true`; else if an `authorization` header is present at all → `auth = { kind: 'none' }`, `bearer = true` (a malformed bearer never falls back to the cookie); else parse the `cookie` header for `khala_local_owner=<v>`; when `v` matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/` and `authenticateCookie(v)` → `{ kind: 'owner', via: 'cookie' }`; otherwise `{ kind: 'none' }`.
7. **Mutation guard**: when `method !== 'GET'` and `auth` is `{ kind: 'owner', via: 'cookie' }`: require `req.headers['x-khala-local'] === '1'` and (`req.headers.origin` absent or exactly equal to `origin`) → else `403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}`.
8. Paths starting with `/api/` or `/open/` go to the **router**; everything else to **static**.
9. **Router**:
   - Body: only for `POST`/`PUT`. `content-length` header greater than the cap → `413` without reading. Otherwise accumulate chunks; past 65 536 bytes → stop buffering, `req.resume()` (discard), respond `413 {"error":"payload_too_large"}` with `connection: close`. Empty body → `undefined`; else `JSON.parse(utf8)`; failure → `400 {"error":"invalid_request"}`. `GET`/`DELETE` → `body = undefined` without reading.
   - Match: routes whose `pattern.test(path)`; the first with equal `method` wins. None matched → `404 {"error":"not_found"}`; matched only with other methods → `405 {"error":"method_not_allowed"}`. `params = match.slice(1).map(decodeURIComponent)`; a `URIError` → `400 invalid_request`. Patterns run against the **encoded** path (so a room id `%21abc%3Alocal` is one segment); params are decoded.
   - Call `route.handle({ method, path, query: url.searchParams, headers: req.headers, body, auth, origin, signal }, params, ctx)`.
   - Write: `'location' in result` → `302`, `location` header. Else `status`, and when `json !== undefined` a body `JSON.stringify(json)` with `content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8`; no body otherwise. Merge `result.headers` (route may set `set-cookie`). Always set `cache-control: no-store` and `x-content-type-options: nosniff` on API responses. If the response is already destroyed (client gone), write nothing.
   - A thrown/rejected handler → `500 {"error":"internal_error"}` and one log line `{"at":"route","method":"POST","route":3,"reason":"TypeError"}` (`route` = array index; `reason` = `error.name` or `'unknown_error'`). Never log the path (it can carry `/open/<token>`), query, headers or body.
10. **Static** (`GET` only; other methods → `405`):
    - `fs.stat(path.join(webDir, 'index.html'))` fails → `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}` (checked per request so building while the helper runs works).
    - `decoded = decodeURIComponent(path)` (URIError → `400 invalid_request`); contains `\0` → `404 not_found`.
    - `file = path.join(webDir, decoded)`; unless `file === webDir` or `file.startsWith(webDir + path.sep)` → `404 not_found`. If it is a regular file and `fs.realpath(file)` is inside `fs.realpath(webDir)` → serve it. Else if `decoded` starts with `/assets/` → `404 not_found`. Else serve `index.html` with `200` (SPA fallback: `/`, `/conversations`, `/channels/<id>`, `/join/<token>`, `/new` …).
    - Headers on every static response: `content-type` from the extension table (`.html` `text/html; charset=utf-8`, `.js`/`.mjs` `text/javascript; charset=utf-8`, `.css` `text/css; charset=utf-8`, `.json` `application/json; charset=utf-8`, `.svg` `image/svg+xml`, `.png` `image/png`, `.ico` `image/x-icon`, `.woff2` `font/woff2`, `.txt` `text/plain; charset=utf-8`, else `application/octet-stream`), `cache-control: no-cache`, `x-content-type-options: nosniff`. HTML responses also get `content-security-policy: <LOCAL_CSP>` and `referrer-policy: no-referrer` (a `/join/<token>` or `/open/<token>` URL must never leak through `Referer`).
11. **Never** send any `access-control-*` header, on any response.

### Invariants

- `server.listen({ host: '127.0.0.1', port })` — never `0.0.0.0`, `::` or `localhost`.
- The idle timer starts when `listen()` resolves, is cleared whenever a request starts, and is re-armed when the in-flight count returns to 0. A long-poll is in flight until its response closes, so it keeps the helper alive. `onIdle` fires once per idle period.
- `LocalRequest.signal` aborts when the response emits `close` before `writableEnded` (client disconnect), and on `close()`.
- No token, cookie value, body, query or path ever reaches `log`.
- No imports beyond `node:http`, `node:fs/promises`, `node:path` and `import type` from `./types`.

### Worked example

Server on port 47830, a cookie session `S` (43 chars) known to `authenticateCookie`, an admin token `A` known to `authenticateBearer` as `{ kind: 'owner', via: 'admin' }`, one route `{ method: 'POST', pattern: /^\/api\/local\/channels\/([^/]+)\/links$/, handle }`.

```text
POST /api/local/channels/%21c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/links
Host: 127.0.0.1:47830
Cookie: khala_local_owner=S
Origin: http://127.0.0.1:47830
x-khala-local: 1
content-type: application/json

{}
→ handle(req, ['!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local'], ctx) with
  req = { method:'POST', path:'/api/local/channels/%21c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/links', body:{}, auth:{kind:'owner',via:'cookie'},
          origin:'http://127.0.0.1:47830', query:URLSearchParams{}, headers:{…}, signal }
← 200 {"shareLink":"http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/…","expiresAt":"…"}   cache-control: no-store, x-content-type-options: nosniff

Same request with Host: evil.test:47830                    ← 421 {"error":"misdirected"}
Same request without x-khala-local                         ← 403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}
Same request with Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3000            ← 403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}
Same request with Authorization: Bearer A, no cookie, no x-khala-local, Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3000
                                                           ← 200 (bearer skips the cookie checks)
GET /channels/%21c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal             ← 200 index.html, content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; …
GET /assets/missing.js                                     ← 404 {"error":"not_found"}
GET /healthz                                               ← 200 {"ok":true,"version":"0.0.0","pid":12345}
```

### Steps

1. Write the constants and types above; `const json = (res, status, value, extra?) => …` sets `content-type`, `cache-control: no-store`, `x-content-type-options: nosniff` and ends with `JSON.stringify(value)`.
2. `createHelperServer(options)`: create `http.createServer(handler)` but do not listen. Keep `let port = 0, origin = '', ctx: HelperContext | undefined, inFlight = 0, idleTimer`, and `const controllers = new Set<AbortController>()`.
3. `listen()`: `new Promise((resolve, reject) => { server.once('error', reject); server.listen({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: options.port }, () => { server.off('error', reject); … }) })`; read `(server.address() as AddressInfo).port`; set `origin`; `ctx = options.createContext(origin)`; arm the idle timer; resolve `{ port, origin }`.
4. `handler(req, res)`: steps 1–11 of the pipeline. Wrap the whole body in `try/catch` → 500 (with the log line) if headers are not yet sent.
5. Abort plumbing per request: `const controller = new AbortController(); controllers.add(controller); res.on('close', () => { if (!res.writableEnded) controller.abort(); controllers.delete(controller); inFlight -= 1; if (inFlight === 0) armIdle(); });`.
6. `armIdle()`: `clearTimeout(idleTimer); idleTimer = setTimeout(() => { if (inFlight === 0) options.onIdle(); }, options.idleMs)`.
7. `close()`: once; `clearTimeout(idleTimer)`; abort every controller; `server.close()` + `server.closeAllConnections()`; resolve on the `close` callback (resolve immediately if never listened).
8. Static file read: `fs.readFile(file)` (assets are small); stream nothing.

## Test scenarios

File: `packages/agent/src/local/http.test.ts`. Start the server with `port: 0`, a temp `webDir` containing `index.html` (`<!doctype html><title>t</title>`) and `assets/app.js`, plus a sibling file `secret.txt` outside `webDir`; a fake `createContext` returning `{ origin, version: '0.0.0', … } as unknown as HelperContext`; `authenticateCookie = v => v === S`; `authenticateBearer = t => t === A ? { kind:'owner', via:'admin' } : t === G ? { kind:'agent', userId:'@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', roomId:'!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local' } : { kind:'none' }`; a recording route that returns `{ status: 200, json: { auth: req.auth, params, body: req.body, query: Object.fromEntries(req.query) } }`. Use `fetch` for normal requests and a small `node:http` `request()` helper for raw `Host` headers and raw paths (fetch normalizes both). Close the server in `afterEach`.

1. **Bind.** `listen()` → `origin === 'http://127.0.0.1:' + port`; `server.address().address === '127.0.0.1'`; `createContext` called once with that origin.
2. **Host guard (AE11).** Raw request `GET /healthz` with `Host: evil.test:<port>` → `421 {"error":"misdirected"}`; `Host: 127.0.0.1:<other>` → 421; `Host: localhost:<port>` → 200.
3. **Healthz.** `GET /healthz` → `{ ok: true, version: '0.0.0', pid: process.pid }`, no `access-control-allow-origin`.
4. **Cookie mutation without header (AE11).** `POST /api/x` with cookie `S`, correct `Origin`, no `x-khala-local` → `403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}`, route not called.
5. **Foreign Origin (AE11).** Cookie `S`, `x-khala-local: 1`, `Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3000` → 403; `Origin: http://localhost:<port>` → 403; no `Origin` header → 200 with `auth: { kind:'owner', via:'cookie' }`.
6. **Cookie GET.** `GET /api/x` with cookie `S` and no header → 200 (guard is for non-GET only).
7. **Bearer skips cookie checks.** `POST /api/x` with `Authorization: Bearer A`, foreign `Origin`, no `x-khala-local` → 200, `auth: { kind:'owner', via:'admin' }`; with `Bearer G` → agent auth; with an unknown bearer plus a valid cookie → `auth: { kind:'none' }` (no fallback to the cookie).
8. **Invalid cookie.** Cookie `khala_local_owner=short` → `auth: { kind:'none' }`, and a POST with it is **not** blocked by the guard (route decides).
9. **Body.** `POST` `{"a":1}` → `body: { a: 1 }`; empty body → `body` absent from the echoed JSON (undefined); `not json` → `400 {"error":"invalid_request"}`, route not called; a `DELETE` with a body → `body` undefined.
10. **413.** `POST` with a 65 537-byte JSON string → `413 {"error":"payload_too_large"}`; exactly 65 536 bytes → 200.
11. **Router.** Pattern `^/api/local/rooms/([^/]+)/events$` (GET) with path `/api/local/rooms/%21c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/events?after=3&wait=0` → `params: ['!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local']`, `query: { after:'3', wait:'0' }`; `POST` to the same path → 405 `method_not_allowed`; `/api/nope` → `404 {"error":"not_found"}`; `%E0%A4%A` in a param → 400.
12. **302.** A route returning `{ status: 302, location: '/channels', headers: { 'set-cookie': 'khala_local_owner=…; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/' } }` → raw response 302 with both headers (use `redirect: 'manual'`).
13. **Errors.** A route that throws `new TypeError('secret-token-xyz /open/abc')` → `500 {"error":"internal_error"}`; the injected `log` received exactly one line, which parses to `{ at:'route', method:'GET', route:<index>, reason:'TypeError' }` and does not contain `secret`, `xyz` or `/open/`.
14. **Static and SPA.** `GET /` and `GET /channels/%21abc%3Alocal` and `GET /join/AAAA…` → 200 `index.html` bytes with `content-security-policy` exactly `LOCAL_CSP`, `referrer-policy: no-referrer`, `cache-control: no-cache`, `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`; `GET /assets/app.js` → the file, `text/javascript; charset=utf-8`, `cache-control: no-cache`, no CSP required; `GET /assets/missing.js` → 404; `POST /channels` → 405.
15. **Traversal.** Raw requests `GET /..%2Fsecret.txt`, `GET /assets/..%2F..%2Fsecret.txt`, `GET /%2e%2e/secret.txt` → never 200 with the secret's bytes (404, or the SPA `index.html` after URL normalization — assert the body never equals `secret.txt`'s content). A symlink `webDir/assets/link.js → ../../secret.txt` → 404.
16. **Build missing.** Delete `index.html` → `GET /conversations` → `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}`; `GET /healthz` still 200; `/api/*` still routed.
17. **No CORS.** `OPTIONS /api/x` with `Origin` and `Access-Control-Request-Method` → 405 and no `access-control-*` header; also assert no `access-control-*` header on scenarios 3, 7 and 14.
18. **Idle fires.** `idleMs: 50` → `onIdle` called once within ~200 ms of `listen()` with no traffic.
19. **Long-poll keeps it alive.** `idleMs: 50`; a GET route that awaits 200 ms (or `req.signal` abort) before answering; `onIdle` is **not** called while it is open; it is called once ~50 ms after the response ends.
20. **Disconnect aborts.** A route that awaits `req.signal` abort and records it; the client aborts its fetch after 20 ms → the route observes `signal.aborted === true` within 200 ms; in-flight returns to 0 (idle fires afterwards).
21. **close().** With a long-poll open, `close()` resolves, the route's signal is aborted, and a new `fetch` fails to connect.

Mutation checks (each must fail a test, then revert): skip the Host guard for `/healthz` (scenario 2); apply the mutation guard to bearer requests (scenario 7); count only non-long-poll requests as in flight (scenario 19); serve a missing `/assets/*` file as `index.html` (scenario 14); drop the `realpath` containment (scenario 15 symlink).

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if KI-110's `types.ts` differs from the L8 block above (especially `LocalResponse`, `LocalRoute`, `LocalAuth`). Do not redefine the types locally.
- **Stop and report** if KI-137 or a route ticket needs the server to mint or store owner cookie sessions itself; by design the server only asks `authenticateCookie`, and setting the cookie is a route's `set-cookie` header.
- If the built `dist-local` (KI-143) turns out to need something `LOCAL_CSP` blocks (a CSP violation in KI-145/KI-160), the fix is an edit to `LOCAL_CSP` in this file with a test update — report it; do not loosen to `'unsafe-eval'` or remote origins.
- Node's built-in `server.requestTimeout` (300 s) and `headersTimeout` defaults are fine for 25 s long-polls; do not lower them.
- In-flight web PRs (#976, #978, #986) do not touch this file.

## Complexity rationale

2: one module with a fixed pipeline and well-known Node APIs; the care is in guard ordering, body capping, traversal and idle accounting, all covered by real-socket tests.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
